import os
from pathlib import Path
from submission_paths import validate_relative_path
root = Path('submission')
total = 0
entries = 0
for base, dirs, files in os.walk(root):
    rel = Path(base).relative_to(root)
    for name in dirs + files:
        path = (rel / name).as_posix()
        validate_relative_path(path)
        entries += 1
        full = Path(base) / name
        if full.is_file():
            total += full.stat().st_size
            full.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
        print('ok', path)
print('entries', entries, 'bytes', total)
